description.value: One20 Public House is a neighbourhood pub in North Delta that bills itself as 'Going Urban in the Burbs,' offering a full food menu spanning tapas, brunch, and desserts alongside draft beer and wine. OSM confirms outdoor seating is available. It sits on the busy Scott Road / 120 St corridor, making it a convenient full-service food-and-drink stop for cyclists passing through the Delta flatlands.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms One20 Public House is an operating neighborhood pub at 8037 120 St, Delta, BC V4C 6P7, with a phone of (604) 591-3519. The OSM address uses 'Scott Road' while the website uses '120 St' — in Delta/Surrey these are the same physical street, but the representations differ so the discrepancy is flagged. Takeout is confirmed via the website's 'Pickup or Delivery' section and a dedicated delivery page listing Uber Eats and Skip; no bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
